messages:
Mia Chen: quick sync — want to lock webinar for May 2. working title: "Operationalizing inference: SLOs, cost, and graceful fallbacks". Primary goal = convert trial users to Dedicated evals + capture Private leads. thoughts?

Arjun Patel: love it. I can demo smart routing + fallback chain. will need ~8-10m for infra + a 90s demo snippet.

Liz Torres: Ill take product narrative + Optimize best practices (12m). will include a cost/latency tradeoff slide and CTAs for trial creds.

Samir Gupta: CS will present a short migration vignette (6-7m). prefer pre-recorded demo clip for customer to avoid bandwidth issues.

marketing-bot: heads-up: slides due 2024-04-12. landing page draft: https://airtable.com/shrExample. promo schedule suggested: announce 2024-04-18, speakers 2024-04-24, reminder 2024-04-30.

Nathan Lee: customer ok with pre-record; can do 6m clip and join live for Qs. will deliver clip by 2024-04-14.

Mia Chen: draft run-of-show (50m):
- 00:00-03:00 welcome + goals (Mia)
- 03:00-15:00 product + Optimize (Liz)
- 15:00-25:00 infra routing + demo (Arjun)
- 25:00-33:00 customer vignette (Samir + Nathan)
- 33:00-47:00 live Q&A (panel)
- 47:00-50:00 CTAs + close (Liz + Mia)
Notes: record session to S3, enable captions, two demo fallbacks (pre-record + canned API replay). rehearsal windows: 2024-04-16 09:00 PT or 2024-04-17 11:00 PT. prefer 4/16 09:00 PT.

Arjun Patel: 4/16 09:00 PT works. posting quick benchmark numbers (small/med/large): 99p = 200ms / 320ms / 700ms; median = 50ms / 85ms / 240ms. will attach CSV to runbook. fallback curl snippet:
```
# fallback: replay pre-recorded clip from S3
curl -s -X GET https://s3.redwood.ai/webinars/may02/demo.mp4 -o demo.mp4
# canned API replay
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-3b","input":"Summarize the following: ..."}'
```

Liz Torres: please include token-cost per 1k tokens for each config on the benchmark slide. also want a single-slide SLO recommendation: p50/p95/p99 thresholds and suggested fallbacks.

Samir Gupta: I'll confirm customer privacy & logo approvals by 2024-04-12.

ops-bot: Stream key reservation and captioning: confirmed. rehearsal instance reserved for 2024-04-16 08:30-10:00 PT.

Mia Chen: action recap:
- Liz: final deck + CTAs by 2024-04-12
- Arjun: CSV + chart + demo script + fallback assets by EOD
- Nathan: upload customer clip by 2024-04-14 and confirm speaker name by 2024-04-11
- Samir: privacy approvals by 2024-04-12
- Ops: stream key, captions, rehearsal instance (confirmed)

Nathan Lee: will post clip link here when uploaded.

Arjun Patel: uploaded demo script to runbook and added a 60s fallback clip. rehearsal checklist: mic test, camera on for panel, screen-share rights, pre-queue fallback clips.

Liz Torres: content-lock: please no slide edits after 2024-04-12 unless critical.

Mia Chen: great. I'll send invites and the runbook link. meet at rehearsal 2024-04-16 09:00 PT. any final blockers?

Samir Gupta: none from CS aside from the privacy checkpoint. will update here.

Mia Chen: thanks everyone  closing thread, runbook link + calendar invite inbound. :white_check_mark:
